input.subject: Supplier registration: bank letter needed
input.body:
Dear Nora,

Thank you for registering Al Khaleej Star Steel Fabrication Est. We received your Zakat, GOSI, CR and VAT documents. One document is missing: the bank letter (bank IBAN certificate showing the account holder name and IBAN). Please reply with a copy of it and we will complete your registration.

Kind regards,
Procurement Team
